test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for a Council of Ministers with the Prime Minister at the head to aid and advice the President in the exercise of the President's functions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 74**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 74 **of the **Constitution of India provides for a Council of Ministers with the Prime Minister **at the** head to aid and advise the President in the exercise of his functions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Article
 Explanation
 
 
 
 

 Article 77
 Deals with the conduct of business of the Government of India.
 
 

 Article 74
 Provides for a Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister to aid and advise the President.
 
 

 Article 71
 Pertains to matters relating to the election of the President and Vice-President.
 
 

 Article 72
 Deals with the powers of the President to grant pardons, reprieves, respites, or remissions of punishment.
